'''Trueping's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was located in [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum district G17]], next to [[Galaxy Noodles/Legends|Galaxy Noodles]] and [[Noodle Bar/Legends|Noodle Bar]], between [[Chezdeze/Legends|Chezdeze]] and a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]].<ref>The entrance to Trueping's is briefly seen in [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum district G17]] in a [[Wikipedia:Long shot|wide shot]] from "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," right before [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] says, "This isn't happening" (seen [[:File:Slum district G17.png|here]]). Signage for [[Chezdeze/Legends|Chezdeze]] appears on the right side of the entrance, while signage for the [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]] is on the left side (although the sign for the massage parlor is illegible). In "[[Deception]]," the very same location is reused for an [[Wikipedia:Establishing shot|establishing shot]] of the entrance to Trueping's (seen [[:File:Truepings-Deception.png|here]]).</ref> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] after supposedly killing [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] went there to celebrate. It may have been a dodgy cantina, but it was very popular, with posters promoting it.

==Staff==
Trueping's employed at least one or two [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]]. The most notable one was [[Unidentified Anacondan/Legends|the Anacondan]] who hung from a rack and used his tail and coil to serve [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]] and take [[Currency/Legends|money]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The name of the bar appears to be a reference to ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' concept artist [[Tara Rueping|'''T'''ara '''Rueping''']].
